standard_prerequisites.name: A flat local ring map is faithfully flat
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Algebra, Lemma algebra-lemma-local-flat-ff, invoked at proof lines 2162-2164
standard_prerequisites.use: Upgrades surjectivity of the stalk map after tensoring to surjectivity of the stalk map itself, which is the only point where the flatness hypothesis is used.

standard_prerequisites.name: The pullback of a sheaf of modules as a tensor product of the inverse image sheaf with the structure sheaf
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard, used at proof lines 2143-2146 to rewrite generators of the pullback as sums of tensors
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the chosen generators of the pulled back sheaf to be expressed through sections of the original sheaf.

standard_prerequisites.name: Finite type for a sheaf of modules, checked on stalks and localised on an open neighbourhood
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Standard, used at proof lines 2141-2142 and again at proof lines 2165-2166
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the global assertion to producing finitely many generators in a neighbourhood of each point of the target.

core_obligations: Fix a point y of the target and a preimage x, and choose an open neighbourhood U of x together with finitely many sections of the pullback that generate it over U (proof lines 2140-2142).

Using the tensor description of the pullback, rewrite each of those generators, after shrinking U, as a finite sum of tensors of an inverse image section with a section of the structure sheaf (proof lines 2143-2146).

Shrink further so that the inverse image sections come from sections of the original sheaf over some open V containing the image of U, and form the resulting map from a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf on V to the original sheaf (proof lines 2147-2153).

Observe that the pullback of this map is surjective, hence that the tensor product of its stalk map at the image point with the stalk of the structure sheaf is surjective, and conclude that the stalk map itself is surjective because the local ring map is flat and therefore faithfully flat (proof lines 2154-2164).
Use openness of the morphism to see that the image of U is an open neighbourhood of y, so that the finitely many sections witness finite type at y (proof lines 2165-2166).
proof_roadmap: Choose local generators of the pullback and rewrite them as sums of tensors (proof lines 2140-2146).
Descend the generators to sections of the original sheaf and build a map from a finite direct sum (proof lines 2147-2153).
Pass from surjectivity after tensoring to surjectivity of the stalk map by faithful flatness (proof lines 2154-2164).
Promote the neighbourhood by openness and conclude (proof lines 2165-2166).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a morphism of locally ringed spaces that is open on underlying spaces and surjective and flat, a sheaf of modules on the target is of finite type as soon as its pullback is (statement lines 2126-2137). The proof is a stalkwise argument carried out with explicit bookkeeping. It chooses a point of the target and a preimage, picks finitely many sections generating the pullback over an open neighbourhood of that preimage, and then uses the description of the pullback as a tensor product of the inverse image sheaf with the structure sheaf to rewrite those generators as finite sums of tensors (proof lines 2140-2146); after shrinking it may assume the inverse image sections come from sections of the original sheaf over an open set of the target, which produces a map from a finite direct sum of the structure sheaf to the original sheaf (proof lines 2147-2153). The pullback of that map is surjective by construction, and the substance of the argument is the step from surjectivity after tensoring with the stalk of the structure sheaf to surjectivity of the original stalk map, which uses that the local ring map is flat and hence faithfully flat (proof lines 2154-2164). Openness of the morphism then promotes the neighbourhood on which the generators live back to a neighbourhood of the chosen point of the target (proof lines 2165-2166). The claim is H2: the tensor rewriting is bookkeeping, but the faithfully flat descent of the surjectivity of a stalk map is the real step, and it is displayed rather than cited.
